repos_data.description: 🔥 Official Firecrawl MCP Server - Adds powerful web scraping and search to Cursor, Claude and any other LLM clients.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for Graphlit Platform
MCP server for Naver Search API integration. Provides comprehensive search capabilities across Naver services (web, news, blog, shopping, etc) and data trend analysis tools via DataLab API.
Production ready MCP server with real-time search & extract in Google, Amazon, YouTube, Walmart, Reddit, TikTok and Instagram
Open-source web search API and MCP server for LLMs, AI agents, and RAG. Free sources, self-hosted SearXNG, REST, CLI.

SERPdive MCP server: real-time web search with answer-ready results for Claude, Cursor and any MCP client. A Tavily alternative: same speed, 20.2% fewer tokens, higher answer quality (60.7% of decided duels). Hosted at mcp.serpdive.com or npx serpdive-mcp.
